item.title: Article: Weightlifting, Not Forklifting: Advice for Growing Up with AI
item.description: Nobody knows what the AI future looks like, so don't bet a kid's childhood on one version of it. Five rules for parents and mentors that hold up either way: keep the workouts, hedge, ask how do you know, protect the human parts, and don't panic.

item.title: Thread: Growing up with AI
item.description: What should kids and teens practice for themselves and what can they hand to AI, and what does the evidence say so far? An essay of advice for kids, teens and future generations growing up with powerful AI.
